description: One operation of a connector, with the fields the modeler fills in. Either dispatches to a registered Python handler or performs a fully declarative HTTP request.

fields.description: Stable id used in the BPMN XML (spiffworkflow:operation), e.g. createFile.
fields.label: Operation ID

fields.description: Shown in the Operation dropdown in the modeler.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: The provider's own API method, for documentation, e.g. files.create.
fields.label: API Method

fields.description: Each row becomes an input in the Service Task properties panel, in this order.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Leave blank to inherit the connector's execution type.
fields.label: Execution Type

fields.description: Dotted path to a handler(params, ctx) -> dict function. Blank falls back to the @connector registry entry for (connector, operation).
fields.label: Handler Path

fields.description: Absolute, or relative to the connector's Base URL. Jinja is available, e.g. /files/{{ params.file }}/content. Field values live under params; doc, task_data, instance and frappe are also in scope.
fields.label: URL Template

fields.description: JSON object of query-string parameters; values are Jinja-rendered. Empty values are dropped.
fields.label: Query Parameters (JSON)

fields.description: JSON object of request headers; values are Jinja-rendered. Auth headers are added automatically.
fields.label: Headers (JSON)

fields.description: Jinja-rendered, then parsed as JSON when Content Type is JSON. Example: {"name": "{{ params.filename }}"}.
fields.label: Body Template

fields.description: JSON object mapping output keys to dotted paths in the response, e.g. {"id": "data.id", "link": "data.webViewLink"}. Use [0] for list indices. Blank returns the whole response under {"response": …}.
fields.label: Response Map (JSON)

fields.description: JSON object documenting what this operation returns, e.g. {"id": "File id"}. Shown to modelers; not used at runtime.
fields.label: Output (JSON)

name: BPMN Connector Operation
